scope: Actual installed Chrome native press/release and missing-press replay from focused inputs. Model, clipboard, file-picker and download side effects intercepted. Does not certify the user Safari trackpad hardware.

checks.name: Missing-press tap executes the current code exactly once
Ordinary press waits until release and invokes once
Dragging off a button cancels execution
Dragging onto a button does not execute
Reset works on the first tap from the editor
Undo replacement restores the prior draft with one tap
Stop cancels a real bounded browser worker on the first tap
Check/explain dispatches once (model response explicitly intercepted)
Copy fix works once and preserves the original; system clipboard is intercepted
lab-import activates once (file chooser/download intercepted)
lab-download activates once (file chooser/download intercepted)
Details/summary opens with one tap from the editor
Output/review tabs activate on the first tap without calling the model
Disabled controls never activate
Control-click/context-menu gestures are not converted into an execution
Keyboard Enter invokes exactly once
Keyboard Space invokes exactly once
Native touch tap keeps one activation without a mouse fallback
Catalogue navigation remains one tap
Header share button works once; clipboard remains intercepted
Theme control changes state once from a focused editor
Source-style links activate once from the editor (navigation intercepted)
